concept: An arcade. Clawd walks a row of glowing arcade cabinets; each tool is a cabinet that boots up when he drops a coin, and its mini-game shows what the tool does. A high-score board on the back wall fills one row per tool.
shows_off: the listicle format from VOICE.md, a game-familiar world, one long take per chapter, brush/splat/iris transitions varied across chapters, astronaut Clawd on the final 'ship it' beat
how_to_use: Replace the four <TOOL> lines with real tools and one plain-words benefit each, from facts the user gives or you can source. Never invent a number.

lines.text: Don't start your next project until you've seen these four free tools.
One: <TOOL 1>. <what it does for you, in plain words>.
Comment TOOLS and I'll send you all four links.
